verdict.rationale: Luma documents a character-reference input for its video model and says Luma Agents carry style references, character references, and visual grounding into every asset, which addresses consistency across multiple generations. However, the cross-shot claim is brief marketing copy, and Multi-Keyframe and Modify Video only control what holds within a single clip, so cross-shot consistency itself is unproven. missing for 10: documentation of how character references persist across separate shots, any stated limits or fidelity guarantees for multi-shot consistency, and hands-on or independent evidence of characters staying consistent across clips.

support.subject: As a creator, a character or scene stays consistent across multiple generated shots, not just within one clip
